results.content:
DeepXL Corp is contractually obliged to notify DeepXL AS within twenty-four hours of becoming aware of a breach affecting Customer Content, which is shorter than DeepXL AS’s own obligation because it cannot meet that obligation unless it is told first.
 Where a public authority requests Customer Content, DeepXL notifies the customer unless prohibited by law, challenges the request where there are reasonable grounds to consider it unlawful, and does not disclose without informing the customer first unless prohibited. [...] ## 12. Reporting a vulnerability

Report a suspected vulnerability to security@deepxl.ai. DeepXL will acknowledge receipt, investigate, and keep the reporter informed of the outcome. DeepXL will not pursue a good-faith reporter who tests only against their own account, does not access or alter another customer’s data, does not degrade the Services, and gives DeepXL a reasonable opportunity to remediate before publishing. Clause 3.3 of the API Terms otherwise prohibits probing and benchmarking, and this paragraph does not authorise it.

## 13. Customer and audit rights [...] Where a processing operation fails, content from a submitted file may appear in an error log. Those logs are held in the same subscription and region and are deleted after 30 days. This is disclosed because it is the one place Customer Content exists outside the storage covered by section 7.

## Real-Time Defense Against AI-Powered Fraud [...] #### What does DeepXL detect?

  DeepXL is a forensic AI platform that detects manipulated documents, fake or altered IDs, and fraudulent images. It scans paystubs, invoices, contracts, and financial records; verifies passports, driver's licenses, and ID cards; and analyzes claim photos for edits, reused stock images, and AI-generated fakes.
 #### How accurate is DeepXL?

  DeepXL detects AI-generated and manipulated content with 95–99.5% accuracy, checking every file against hundreds of forensic signals to catch even advanced tampering in real time.
 #### Who is DeepXL built for? [...] Yes. DeepXL goes beyond a pass/fail score — it analyzes file origins, structure, and consistency across submissions, then returns clear confidence scores and evidence for every finding so your team can make defensible decisions.
 #### How does DeepXL handle data security and compliance?

  DeepXL is built with enterprise-grade security. Data is stored securely with advanced encryption, and the platform follows industry-standard practices and compliance requirements expected in finance, insurance, and government.
 #### How is DeepXL priced?

  DeepXL uses a flexible, usage-based model for organizations processing anywhere from hundreds to millions of files. Contact our team for enterprise pricing tailored to your volume and use case.
